datasets.name: 11aa22bb
queryLines:
SELECT
  MAX(service_date) AS latest_service_date,
  COUNT(*) AS missed_service_windows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT line_sign) AS affected_lines,
  AVG(planned_headway_minutes) AS avg_planned_headway_minutes,
  AVG(headway_deviation_minutes) AS avg_headway_deviation_minutes
FROM main.gold.gold_planned_vs_observed_service_adherence_hourly
WHERE missed_service_flag = TRUE
  AND (
    :p_service_date_range.min IS NULL
    OR :p_service_date_range.max IS NULL
    OR service_date BETWEEN CAST(:p_service_date_range.min AS DATE)
                        AND CAST(:p_service_date_range.max AS DATE)
  )
  AND (
    :p_gtfs_direction_id = 'ALL'
    OR CAST(gtfs_direction_id AS STRING) = :p_gtfs_direction_id
  )
  AND (
    :p_line_sign = 'ALL'
    OR line_sign = :p_line_sign
  )

datasets.name: 22bb33cc
queryLines:
WITH missed_base AS (
  SELECT
    line_sign,
    gtfs_direction_id,
    COUNT(*) AS missed_service_windows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT service_date) AS affected_service_days,
    AVG(planned_headway_minutes) AS avg_planned_headway_minutes,
    AVG(headway_deviation_minutes) AS avg_headway_deviation_minutes
  FROM main.gold.gold_planned_vs_observed_service_adherence_hourly
  WHERE missed_service_flag = TRUE
    AND (
      :p_service_date_range.min IS NULL
      OR :p_service_date_range.max IS NULL
      OR service_date BETWEEN CAST(:p_service_date_range.min AS DATE)
                          AND CAST(:p_service_date_range.max AS DATE)
    )
    AND (
      :p_gtfs_direction_id = 'ALL'
      OR CAST(gtfs_direction_id AS STRING) = :p_gtfs_direction_id
    )
    AND (
      :p_line_sign = 'ALL'
      OR line_sign = :p_line_sign
    )
  GROUP BY line_sign, gtfs_direction_id
)
SELECT
  rt.latitude,
  rt.longitude,
  rt.line_sign,
  rt.route_id,
  rt.route_long_name,
  rt.route_name_display,
  rt.gtfs_direction_id,
  rt.direction_description,
  rt.trip_headsign_reference,
  rt.terminal_role,
  rt.stop_id,
  rt.stop_name,
  rt.representative_first_stop_id,
  rt.representative_last_stop_id,
  rt.endpoint_pair_trip_count,
  mb.missed_service_windows,
  mb.affected_service_days,
  mb.avg_planned_headway_minutes,
  mb.avg_headway_deviation_minutes,
  CASE
    WHEN mb.missed_service_windows >= 20 THEN 'High'
    WHEN mb.missed_service_windows >= 5 THEN 'Medium'
    ELSE 'Low'
  END AS missed_service_risk_band
FROM main.gold.gold_route_terminal_reference rt
INNER JOIN missed_base mb
  ON rt.line_sign = mb.line_sign
 AND rt.gtfs_direction_id = mb.gtfs_direction_id
WHERE (
    :p_terminal_role = 'ALL'
    OR rt.terminal_role = :p_terminal_role
  )
  AND (
    :p_line_sign = 'ALL'
    OR rt.line_sign = :p_line_sign
  )
  AND (
    :p_gtfs_direction_id = 'ALL'
    OR CAST(rt.gtfs_direction_id AS STRING) = :p_gtfs_direction_id
  )
ORDER BY mb.missed_service_windows DESC, rt.line_sign ASC, rt.terminal_role ASC

datasets.name: 33cc44dd
queryLines:
SELECT
  line_sign
FROM (
  SELECT 'ALL' AS line_sign, 0 AS sort_order
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT line_sign AS line_sign, 1 AS sort_order
  FROM main.gold.gold_planned_vs_observed_service_adherence_hourly
  WHERE missed_service_flag = TRUE
    AND (
      :p_service_date_range.min IS NULL
      OR :p_service_date_range.max IS NULL
      OR service_date BETWEEN CAST(:p_service_date_range.min AS DATE)
                          AND CAST(:p_service_date_range.max AS DATE)
    )
    AND (
      :p_gtfs_direction_id = 'ALL'
      OR CAST(gtfs_direction_id AS STRING) = :p_gtfs_direction_id
    )
    AND line_sign IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(line_sign) <> ''
) options
ORDER BY sort_order, line_sign

datasets.name: 44dd55ee
queryLines:
SELECT
  gtfs_direction_id
FROM (
  SELECT 'ALL' AS gtfs_direction_id, 0 AS sort_order
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(gtfs_direction_id AS STRING) AS gtfs_direction_id, 1 AS sort_order
  FROM main.gold.gold_planned_vs_observed_service_adherence_hourly
  WHERE gtfs_direction_id IS NOT NULL
) options
ORDER BY sort_order, gtfs_direction_id

datasets.name: 55ee66ff
queryLines:
SELECT
  terminal_role
FROM (
  SELECT 'ALL' AS terminal_role, 0 AS sort_order
  UNION ALL SELECT 'ORIGIN' AS terminal_role, 1 AS sort_order
  UNION ALL SELECT 'DESTINATION' AS terminal_role, 2 AS sort_order
) options
ORDER BY sort_order, terminal_role
